task_summary: I am a business analyst. I need to understand at a high level how a system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area is expected to work. I know that the application should allow people to report issues in the territory and support the municipality in managing them, but I do not yet know the specific user roles or the functionalities available to each of them. I need to identify the main types of users that interact with the system, the main goals they can achieve through it, and how the different functionalities are related to each other. | understand at a high level how a system works, identify the main types of users and their main goals, and see how functionalities are related | system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area | The diagram must make clear the high-level workflow, main types of users, their main goals, and how the different functionalities are related to each other.

selected_view.purpose: Architecture Decision Record View for business analyst: components affected by recorded decisions. Relations: depends. Do not: inventing decisions not in the repo.
selected_view.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose mermaid: Mermaid can clearly draw the components affected by recorded decisions and their dependencies to address general workflow and flexibility concerns.

required_information.need: decision affecting system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area

architectural_questions.text: What is the general architectural layout and high-level workflow of the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area?
Who are the main types of users that interact with the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area?
What are the primary goals and functionalities that the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area provides to its users?

How are the different functionalities and user goals related to each other within the system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area, given that specific user roles and permissions are not yet fixed?
